text:
incident-bot: Alert 5487 — elevated error rate (timeout/502) on streaming /v1/chat/stream in eu-west-1. Triggered at 2026-03-15T15:10:56Z. Paging oncall sam.
sam: oncall ack, joining. seeing spike from 15:10:30Z.
nina: gateway graph shows ~12% error rate on streaming connections, normal for other endpoints.
raj: tracing shows backend selection failing: `model-router: invalid host header` then immediate drop. suspect proxy layer.
sam: i'm SSH-ing into proxy-01 to tail nginx.
sam: nginx error snippet:
```
2026/03/15 15:10:31 [error] 23456#0: *12345 recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) while reading response header
2026/03/15 15:10:31 [crit] 23456#0: *12345 open socket failed, resource temporarily unavailable
```
olivia: we rolled a config change to frontend proxies ~20m ago to add a header rewrite for partner tokens. change id: cfg-2026-03-15-278.
kevin: that header rewrite altered `Transfer-Encoding` accidentally for chunked responses in some code paths. streaming clients then timeout/fall back to sync requests which hit different runtime code path causing 502s.
sam: immediate mitigation: revert proxy config and enable streaming fallback to a stable host. executing revert now.
sam: `infractl config rollback --id cfg-2026-03-15-278 --env prod --region eu-west-1`
incident-bot: Config rollback executed by sam at 2026-03-15T15:16:02Z.
nina: error rate dropping, now ~0.8% after 90s.
raj: placing proxy-01 and proxy-03 into draining for deeper post-incident analysis.
kevin: verifying customer impact: approx 9.1k requests affected over 6m, heavy from acct-117 and acct-999 (enterprise streaming integrations).
olivia: flagging acct teams and account owners. will coordinate direct outreach.
sam: handoff: i'm going to stay as incident lead for next 30m, then hand to nina. current open items: collect proxy configs, trace samples, reproduce header rewrite failure on staging.
nina: i'll take the next watch. scheduling postmortem: propose Tue 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC (30m). agenda: timeline, config gating, deployment safeguards, customer comms.
kevin: agreed. we should include a KB on safe header rewrites for streaming endpoints.
olivia: customer comms plan: short status page now (resolved), detailed RCA after PM, direct email to impacted accounts with offer for tech sync. draft below.
```
Status: Partial outage (Resolved)
Impact: Some streaming requests to the chat endpoint in eu-west-1 experienced timeouts and 5xx responses between 15:10-15:17 UTC. Approximately 9k requests were impacted; two enterprise accounts experienced degraded streaming.
Mitigation: We rolled back a recent proxy config change and drained affected proxies; streaming resumed within ~2 minutes.
Scope: No customer data exposure detected.
Next steps: Root cause analysis and postmortem scheduled. We will follow up with a detailed RCA and direct account outreach.
```
sam: please add: "We have put a temporary deployment hold on proxy header rewrites until staging pass verifies streaming behavior".
olivia: added. pinging legal and support for review before posting.
raj: creating incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-INC-5487, linking traces and proxy configs.
kevin: repro notes: created test that alters Transfer-Encoding header in staging proxies, reproduces chunking failures. will open PR to runtime lib to tolerate missing header.
sam: action items list — please confirm owners and due dates:
- olivia: draft customer emails + support playbook for impacted accounts | due 2026-03-17
- kevin: runtime toleration patch PR and staging validation | due 2026-03-22
- raj: add config CI gate that warns on header rewrites for streaming endpoints | due 2026-03-25
- nina: run full staging stress test for header rewrite + streaming matrix | due 2026-03-19
- sam: update oncall runbook to include quick rollback command and banner messaging for partners | due 2026-03-20
kevin: PR note: adding safe-guard parsing to runtime so chunked responses don't rely solely on Transfer-Encoding header.
olivia: customer outreach plan: 1) status page now, 2) direct email after PM, 3) optional 30-min technical Q&A for impacted enterprise accounts, 4) follow-up timeline for fixes.
sam: handing off active pager to nina at 15:40 UTC. please keep this thread updated with artifact links.
incident-bot: Incident 5487 marked mitigated by sam at 2026-03-15T15:25:00Z.
nina: noted. I'll collect logs, proxy configs, and sample traces and upload to s3://redwood-incident-5487/artifacts/1819123456/ by EOD.
raj: quick note on customer data: verified headers and logs do not contain PII. safe to state no data exposure.
olivia: drafting email template to affected accounts (will paste here for review).
kevin: after initial fix, we should consider an automated canary that runs streaming smoke checks post-config-rollout. adding to platform backlog.
sam: agreed. add canary to RW-OPS backlog and mark priority P2.
nina: scheduling PM: Tue 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC — calendar invite sent. please add any extra artifacts to RW-INC-5487 before meeting.
olivia: once RCA ready, i'll post status.redwood.ai and send the direct emails. aiming to publish full RCA within 72 hours of PM.
kevin: recording: please include the staging repro steps in the postmortem so eng can replicate.
raj: closing handoff. ongoing monitoring for 1h then clear pager.
sam: :thumbsup: thanks team.
incident-bot: Reminder: Postmortem RW-INC-5487 in ~72h.
